Jun W.: Heads-up — we started seeing steady KV cache growth on gpu-pool-3 after longctx runs (~30k tokens). RSS climbs ~1.2GB per hour.
Maria T.: Interesting, any correlation with fragmentation or pagewalk rates?
Jun W.: Yes; profiler shows pagewalks spiking during large longctx tasks. snippet: `pagewalks/sec: 420 -> 1800; compaction_efficiency: 0.38`
Anya R.: Did this surface after the new kernel-select changes last week? Could be kernel path missing fast-path for compact reuse.
Alex P.: I ran a replay with the old kernel selector — growth stops. So regression seems introduced in 2026-01-22 deploy.
Kevin S.: Logs: `kv_alloc: alloc_pages=10240 free_pages=320 reclaim_attempts=0` — reclaim not triggered because `tenant_quota_refill` threshold changed.
Maria T.: Proposed mitigation: bump per-tenant soft_quota and enable aggressive background compaction for noisy tenants. Also can pin high-residency tenants to fairshare pool.
Jun W.: quick command I used: `./bin/kv_prof --target gpu-pool-3 --duration 300 --emit=pagewalks,frag` output excerpt:
```
# time, pagewalks, frag_ratio
12:01, 1820, 0.63
12:06, 1905, 0.66
```
Alex P.: Repro steps: run longctx 50k tokens w/ concurrent small chats 100qps. Replicated in staging. Reverting kernel selector fixes but isn't ideal.
Anya R.: Short-term: roll back kernel-select patch, enable tenant-level throttle. Long-term: add eviction-feedback into batching heuristic and per-tenant KV watermarks + reclaim travel.
perf-bot: Flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.redwood/fg/1717504321
Kevin S.: I'll open a follow-up RFC for eviction-feedback and add a canary to dedicated pools. @Anya R. @Jun W. can you write brief runbook for oncall? :thumbsup:
Anya R.: on it, will draft runbook and add playbook for noisy-tenant triage.
Jun W.: Thanks. I'll attach profiling traces in the ticket.
